rules: LEVEL_0_NO_CHANGE is mandatory in every candidate set.
Candidate ambition may not exceed PASSAGE_STATE.maximum_edit_scope.
Only ADMIT opportunities may drive candidate generation; REVIEW_CONFLICT requires resolution first.
Every nonzero candidate must cite at least one admitted opportunity and one qualified revision transform.
A transform may not be applied outside its scope_limit or against a countercondition.
Protected language, canon, authorial intent, POV/knowledge boundaries, explicit user constraints, required ambiguity, and semantic core are hard preservation boundaries.
LEVEL_4_APPROACH_CHALLENGE requires explicit development-frontier or user authorization.
Candidate generation must be bounded; default maximum is three nonzero candidates plus LEVEL_0_NO_CHANGE.
The writer/generator may declare targets and expected effects but may not declare a candidate superior to the original or to another candidate.
Every generated nonzero candidate remains UNEVALUATED_PENDING_STEP_I until independent evaluation.
Uncertainty or unresolved critical preservation state yields no nonzero candidate.
